empty_body: See its profile, timeline and connections. Ask Persona hands it to the main chat.
ask_title: Bring this entry's profile and recent progress into Persona's main chat
new_agent_title: Start an agent with this project's profile and recent progress
merged_hint: It's the same thing as another project, so its timeline, chats and people moved there. This shows how it looked before the merge.
directory_hint: Persona, the AI twin and the agents on your computers can all read this folder directly.
search_in_name: "{query}" is in the name or details
recording_partial: Still transcribing; the rest will follow
minutes_failed: Couldn’t write the minutes. Try regenerating them.
minutes_waiting: Minutes will be written when transcription finishes.
minutes_partial: The end of this long transcript was not read. These minutes may be incomplete.
minutes_stale: The minutes changed. Loading the latest version; review the action items before adding them.
minutes_refresh_failed: Couldn’t load the latest minutes. Refresh before trying again: {error}
minutes_ai_note: AI-generated from the recording. Check anything important.
asks_empty: No questions yet. Questions asked on the phone during the meeting appear here.
live_following_one: Following the meeting live · {count} line passed on
live_following_other: Following the meeting live · {count} lines passed on
live_waiting: Following the meeting live · waiting for the first lines
live_catching_up: Catching up · {fed} of {next} lines passed on
live_off: Persona isn’t attending right now. Earlier questions stay here.
live_problem_attendee_unavailable: The attending session can’t take messages right now. Lines are kept and passed on once it can.
live_problem_attendee_not_allowed: This session can’t be given other people’s words. Questions still work.
live_problem_live_full: This meeting reached the limit for live lines. Questions still work.
live_problem_other: Persona can’t follow this meeting right now.
ask_spoken: Said to Persona on the phone
ask_failed_model_unavailable: Couldn’t answer: no model is set up, or it is paused.
ask_failed_model_error: Couldn’t answer: the model returned an error.
ask_failed_model_timeout: Couldn’t answer: the model took too long.
ask_failed_interrupted: Interrupted when the hub restarted. Ask again on the phone.
ask_failed_nothing_heard: Nothing was said just before the tap.
ask_failed_room_unavailable: Persona couldn’t reach the meeting’s conversation. Ask again on the phone.
private_on: Its minutes are never used when Persona answers in later meetings.
private_off: Persona may use its minutes to answer in later meetings.
private_unset: Not chosen yet, so it counts as private: its minutes are never used in later meetings.
conversation_open_followup: Open the conversation after the meeting
conversation_earlier: Earlier messages are in the conversation.
conversation_read_only: Questions are asked on the phone while the meeting runs. Once it ends, you can talk about it here.
room_none: Persona isn’t taking part in this meeting.
room_ready_listener: Persona is in the meeting as a listener · answers show on screen only
room_ready_participant: Persona is in the meeting as a participant · answers can be said aloud
room_ready_off: Persona is in the meeting but isn’t listening right now.
room_problem_runtime_unsupported: The assistant’s computer can’t run a meeting conversation. Questions are answered from the meeting’s material.
room_problem_node_too_old: The assistant’s computer needs a newer Persona to take part. Questions are answered from the meeting’s material.
room_problem_machine_offline: The assistant’s computer is offline. Persona tries again every minute; until then, questions are answered from the meeting’s material.
room_problem_start_failed: Persona couldn’t join the meeting and tries again every minute. Until then, questions are answered from the meeting’s material.
room_problem_other: Persona can’t take part in this meeting right now.
room_ended_copy: The meeting is over. A copy of its conversation is still on the assistant’s computer and is deleted once that computer can be reached.
room_deleted: The meeting’s conversation was deleted with its transcript.
thread_via_spoken: Said to Persona on the phone
photos_trimmed: The transcript has expired. Only the photos the minutes use are kept.
live_empty: Lines show here as the meeting is heard.
live_earlier: Earlier lines are in the transcript.
followup_placeholder: Ask what was decided, or what to do next…
followup_hint: Starts a conversation with the meeting’s material
followup_running: The meeting is still running. Once it ends, you can talk about it here.
followup_no_material: This meeting has no transcript or minutes to talk about yet.
followup_unknown: Not sure this was sent yet. Send again to check: it won’t be sent twice.
minutes_kept_until: The transcript has expired. These minutes are kept until {date}.
minutes_transcript_expired: The transcript has expired. Only these minutes are kept.
minutes_kept_forever: The transcript has expired. These minutes are kept until you delete them.
recap_absent: The recap is written in the evening.
recap_no_text: The recap is written once there’s a transcript.
recap_failed: Couldn’t write the recap. Try again.
recap_final_cutoff: Final recap. Some of the day may not have been transcribed.
recap_parts_failed: Couldn’t load the other parts of the day.
recap_partial: This day was too long to read in full, so parts of it are left out.
recap_stale: The recap changed. Loading the latest version; review the suggested to-dos before adding them.
recap_refresh_failed: Couldn’t load the latest recap. Refresh before trying again: {error}
recap_kept_until: The transcript has expired. This recap is kept until {date}.
recap_transcript_expired: The transcript has expired. Only this recap is kept.
recap_kept_forever: The transcript has expired. This recap is kept until you delete it.
